subject: english
title: Grammar Cup — Nouns & Verbs Test
subtitle: 30 questions across 5 rounds. One try each, instant feedback, then a score and a training plan showing which stations to replay.

content: Spot nouns and verbs inside real sentences, including the tricky case where the verb is BE.
Show the noun sub-skills under test conditions: capitals, plurals and rebels, countable vs uncountable, possessive 's, and compound nouns.
Read the round-by-round result bars and know which station to replay.
language: Sort words into noun, verb, and describing word.
Choose correct plurals, BE forms, third-person -s, and past forms.
Choose correct word order, articles, helpers, and possessive forms.
